entities.name: Operational Decision Dashboard
entities.scope: Dashboards that help operators interpret status, risk, priority, and next action from bounded product data.
entities.rationale: Operational UI quality depends on task state, evidence, recovery, and scanning structure before surface styling.

metrics.value: Primary decision, risk, evidence, and next action must be represented before implementation readiness.

entities.name: AI Workspace
entities.scope: Workspaces where a user supplies input, configures generation or analysis, reviews machine output, and exports bounded evidence.
entities.rationale: AI workspaces need visible source boundaries, review states, provenance, and export constraints so generated output is not mistaken for verified product state.

metrics.value: Generated, simulated, cached, failed, and reviewed outputs must be visibly distinguishable.

entities.name: Diagnose Operational Risk
entities.scope: A user identifies what is happening, what changed, why it matters, and what action should happen next.
entities.rationale: The benchmarked product contracts show that usable operational dashboards must support diagnosis without requiring users to infer data origin or task state.

entities.name: Continue Local Creative Workflow
entities.scope: A user starts a local-first project, preserves state across workflow steps, reviews assets, and exports an offline result.
entities.rationale: The SceneStart benchmark validates that creative tools still need product contracts, persistence, review, rights confirmation, and offline export evidence.

entities.name: Source Boundary And Recovery State
entities.scope: Live, demo, simulated, cached, offline, failed, and exported states across result, history, and download surfaces.
entities.rationale: Trustworthy interfaces preserve the origin and freshness of a result through the complete user journey, including failure and export.

metrics.value: Every consequential output has visible source mode, freshness, and recovery behavior.

entities.name: Architecture Modularity
entities.scope: Component boundaries, state ownership, file size, and dependency direction for generated and repaired applications.
entities.rationale: Maintainability is a product quality attribute. It is enforced through bounded component responsibilities and architecture checks, not visual preference.

metrics.value: Flag bloated components and mixed responsibilities before release qualification.

entities.name: Semantic Token Contract
entities.scope: Color, spacing, radius, typography, motion, and state values are exposed through named semantic tokens.
entities.rationale: Semantic tokens make design decisions portable and auditable while preventing hidden raw styling from drifting across generated surfaces.

metrics.value: Reject raw visual constants in authored UI where a semantic token should express the decision.

entities.name: Task Workspace
entities.scope: The primary work surface that binds user task, state, source disclosure, result, recovery action, and export or handoff.
entities.rationale: A workspace component should own workflow presentation while domain state and data interpretation remain in explicit modules.

entities.name: Operational Answer Flow
entities.scope: What am I viewing, what changed, what is the impact, why, what next, and how do I verify.
entities.rationale: Information hierarchy should answer operational questions in order instead of presenting decorative metrics or disconnected cards.

entities.name: Task-Bound Action
entities.scope: Every consequential button, route, upload, save, retry, export, and drill-down is tied to declared task state and observable evidence.
entities.rationale: Interaction is complete only when it changes meaningful product state or reports a bounded limitation; placeholder controls are rejected.

entities.name: Readable Visual Rhythm
entities.scope: Visual density, contrast hierarchy, whitespace, grouping, chart legibility, and responsive rhythm for dashboards and workspaces.
entities.rationale: Visual polish is treated as an auditable composition outcome with review evidence, not as a style catalog or decoration layer.

metrics.value: High-priority content remains scan-friendly without text walls or competing signals at each declared viewport.

entities.name: WCAG-Oriented Operability Gate
entities.scope: Keyboard operation, focus visibility, focus not obscured, reflow, text resizing, contrast, target sizing, accessible names, and reduced motion.
entities.rationale: Accessibility requirements must cite official authority when presented as requirements and must be verified separately from visual preference.

metrics.value: Quality gates cover applicable WCAG 2.2 oriented runtime checks and disclose any unverified criterion.

entities.name: Evidence Class Separation
entities.scope: Automated evidence, AI-assisted expert review, human expert review, representative-user evidence, and owner maintenance review remain separate.
entities.rationale: Evidence quality cannot be upgraded by wording. Human review, representative-user testing, and automated checks answer different questions.

entities.name: Product Contract Validation
entities.scope: Validate product archetype, tasks, states, acceptance criteria, evidence methods, and benchmark references before implementation.
entities.rationale: A design cannot be production-grounded when the task model and acceptance evidence are missing or contradictory.

entities.name: Browser Runtime Quality Gate
entities.scope: Run viewport, interaction, source disclosure, accessibility, overflow, clipping, focus, motion, media, network, and journey checks against a live UI.
entities.rationale: Rendered behavior catches failures that static code and design prose cannot prove.

entities.name: Static Architecture Audit
entities.scope: Scan source for component size, raw design values, mixed responsibilities, mock production paths, placeholder interactions, and state disclosure problems.
entities.rationale: Architecture and anti-slop checks provide deterministic guardrails before browser evidence is available.

entities.name: Structured Review Evaluation
entities.scope: Evaluate heuristic, maintainer, human expert, and representative-user review records without substituting one evidence class for another.
entities.rationale: Structured review turns subjective feedback into bounded findings, severity, confidence, remediation, and validation methods.

entities.name: Accessibility And Truth Override Polish
entities.scope: When visual polish conflicts with accessibility, data provenance, or task success, the verified product and accessibility constraints win.
entities.rationale: A visually impressive interface is not acceptable when it hides source mode, breaks task completion, or becomes unreadable.

entities.name: Narrow Evidence-Bound Runtime Exemption
entities.scope: Allow runtime exemptions only on the smallest owning element with separate evidence for permitted tables, code, essential motion, or sampler limitations.
entities.rationale: Exemptions explain valid constraints; they must not become global annotations that hide product failures.

entities.name: Knowledge Gap Instead Of Private Fallback
entities.scope: Unsupported, ungrounded, unknown-origin, private-source-only, or conflicting requests return an explicit gap instead of invented guidance.
entities.rationale: The system must preserve independence and credibility by refusing to fill missing authority from private archives or assumptions.

relationships.rationale: Operational dashboards activate diagnosis as their primary task.
Risk diagnosis requires source and recovery state to avoid misleading decisions.
The answer flow structures what the diagnostic task needs to learn first.
The task workspace presents task state, outputs, actions, and evidence.
Components use semantic tokens rather than isolated raw styling.
Rendered workflow evidence verifies the component behaves under declared viewports.
Static checks verify architecture and anti-slop constraints before release.
Review evidence must retain its evidence class and attribution.
Accessibility constraints override visual choices that reduce operability.
Truthful data-origin state overrides visual simplification.
Only narrow evidence-bound exceptions may modify runtime accessibility findings.
Unsupported diagnostic tasks must return a gap instead of private fallback guidance.
AI workspaces activate local workflow continuation when they create or transform user artifacts.

conflicts.when: A visual treatment improves apparent polish but reduces text contrast, focus visibility, target operability, or reduced-motion support.
conflicts.resolution: Keep or redesign the visual treatment only if the browser runtime gate and applicable review evidence preserve operability.

conflicts.when: A concise layout hides demo mode, data freshness, source limits, failed work, or export provenance.
conflicts.resolution: Expose the source boundary and recovery state in the task flow before optimizing density.
